subject: grad
title: GRAD. ------ INFO.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 128 (AE(PD)-16). GRAD (gradualism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) and INFO-TRNS (information transference). From CR-INFO-DY: DYM-SEP (dynamic separation) and IST-F (isolated focus). From INFO-TRNS: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From DYM-SEP: INT (intention). From IST-F: CRT (criticism) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From INFO-AF-B: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions).
